items.title: Fox (FOXA) Closes Roku Deal And Puts Anthony Wood In Digital Leadership
items.summary: Fox (NasdaqGS:FOXA) has completed its acquisition of streaming platform Roku, closing a major deal in digital media. Roku founder Anthony Wood is joining the Fox board and will help lead the newly created FOX Digital Platforms division. The FOX Digital Platforms unit is intended to house and coordinate Fox's streaming and connected TV assets alongside its traditional media operations.
